units.source_text: 因为是在电话里，我是什么样的表情，表兄自然无从知晓。

en.t: Because we were on the telephone, my cousin naturally had no way of knowing what expression was on my face.

units.source_text: 我对家人说，我要去参加第三次葬礼。

en.t: I told my family that I was going to attend a third funeral.

units.source_text: 这家的年轻的表嫂苦笑着说：你简直像殡仪馆的人啦。

en.t: The young wife of my cousin in that household gave a wry smile and said, You are practically like someone from a funeral home.

units.source_text: 表妹在做着针线活，她瞅了一眼我的脸。

en.t: My female cousin was doing needlework, and she glanced at my face.

units.source_text: 我决定当晚在摄津的家住宿，次日清晨再从那儿出发，就这样我渡过了淀川。

en.t: I decided to stay that night at the house in Settsu and set out from there the next morning, and so I crossed the Yodo River.
